tools.name: search_brands
tools.description: Find a casino and its documented official domain in Casimo Research. Use for identity, terms and redemption questions; a tracked listing is not a safety endorsement.

tools.name: get_brand
tools.description: Get the latest captured casino facts, dates, source excerpts, and explicit unknowns. Use when asked about an operator’s terms or payout conditions. Cite the supplied Casimo and original source URLs.

tools.name: list_recent_events
tools.description: Read actual observed differences between source versions. Observation dates are not effective dates; no historical changes are invented.

tools.name: get_payout_sample
tools.description: Get the voluntary payout observation sample for a casino. Does not infer an all-player rate or promised arrival date from public complaints or completed-only reports.

tools.name: list_conversations
tools.description: List published conversations for a known casino or research topic. Editorial roles and reader contributions have different provenance.

tools.name: get_conversation
tools.description: Get a published room, labeled editorial positions, moderated reader replies and source-answer history. No private receipts, inbox or workspace keys are exposed.

tools.name: get_missing_proof
tools.description: Read open and source-found questions for a brand. A source answer is not a verified payment or personal eligibility clearance.

tools.name: get_knowledge_loss
tools.description: Read actual loss-of-source-support events and directed registered-source checks. A lost source is not an allegation against an operator.

tools.name: get_source_map
tools.description: Read actual parent edges, crosspost IDs and explicit source links. Does not infer identities, copied facts or independent payment cases.

tools.name: get_public_receipt
tools.description: Read a public source-only receipt and current-ledger differences. Never accepts or returns a private notebook or commercial contract.

tools.name: get_market_watch
tools.description: Get actually captured package units, source dates and official matched app-version observations. An advertised package is not an approved affiliate offer or guaranteed cash.

tools.name: get_amoe_source
tools.description: Get short source-scoped wording leads for AMOE. Missing postal, handwriting, code, state and cadence instructions remain unknown; no entry is generated.
